'''''Carex pendula''''' ('''pendulous sedge''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> also known as '''hanging''', '''drooping''' or '''weeping sedge''') is a large [[Cyperaceae|sedge]] of the [[genus]] ''[[Carex]]''. It occurs in [[woodland]], [[scrubland]], [[Hedge (barrier)|hedges]] and beside streams, preferring damp, heavy [[clay]] [[soil]]s. It is sometimes grown as a garden plant because of its distinctive appearance.

It is native to western, central and southern parts of [[Europe]] occurring north to [[Sweden]], [[Denmark]] and parts of [[Scotland]] where it reaches [[58th parallel north|58° N]].{{citation needed|date=April 2015}} It is also found in north-west [[Africa]], the [[Azores]], [[Madeira]] and parts of the [[Middle East]].<ref>{{GRIN | accessdate=23 July 2008}}</ref>

==Description== 
[[Image:Carex pendula0.jpg|right|thumb|upright|Inflorescence: one male spike (left) and four female spikes]]
''Carex pendula'' is a tall, [[perennial plant]] which forms large, dense tufts. It can grow to 1.8 metres, occasionally reaching 2.4 metres. The smooth [[plant stem|stem]]s are triangular in cross-section with rounded angles. The long, hairless [[leaf|leaves]] are yellowish-green above and [[glaucous]] below. They are 8–20 mm wide. The simple [[flower]]s are borne on long, drooping, [[catkin]]-like spikes. There are 1–2 male spikes at the top of the stem with usually 4–5 female spikes below them. The male spikes are 55–160 mm long while the females spikes are 50–260 mm long and 5–7 mm wide. The [[fruit]]s are green-brown and 3–5 mm long with a 1–2.5-mm beak. The plant typically flowers from May to June and fruits from June to July.

It has been [[introduced species|introduced]] to [[New Zealand]] and has begun to spread into the wild in the [[United States]], where it has been recorded from [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[Virginia]], and [[California]].<ref>Flora of North America. [http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242357395 ''Carex pendula'']. Accessed 23 July 2008.</ref><ref>CalFlora. [https://www.calflora.org/app/taxon?crn=10523 ''Carex pendula''].
